purpose: Carry the protected capture owner's existing native timing stages into its exact activation reply before attributing the observed 324ms activation outlier to a particular Windows API.

baseline.gap: Protected capture called Activate without a profiling context. Only scope/apply buckets crossed the worker pipe; the detailed owner stages already present in wininput did not reach the agent.

change.storage: Activation replies alone reuse bytes 52..55 and 60..63; other operations retain zero padding and their existing pointer fields.
change.projection: capture.native is separate from agent capture.micros and measured. Nested stages are not additive. A sealed owner probe cannot mutate an emitted reply or a later command.
change.privacy: Fixed numeric buckets only; no window handles, titles, paths, keys, clipboard data or authority identifiers.
change.compatibility: All-zero legacy detail remains valid. Older decoders reject nonzero reserved bytes. Deploy the agent and protected capture worker as one matching installed revision; this is not a mixed-revision IPC upgrade.
change.security: Malformed buckets, unused bits, truncated frames and detail on non-activation packets remain protocol errors. Only an exactly matched activation reply can attach details. Negative replies remain failures; timings grant no input or retirement authority.

validation.focused: PASS: capture probes, fixed-size source protocol, native activation success/rejection, reply identity and diagnostic export tests.
validation.vetLimit: Default wininput vet reports eight existing unsafe.Pointer diagnostics in unchanged callback/surface files. Those warnings were not fixed by this diagnostic change.
validation.physical: PENDING: collect new matched source handoffs with the updated protected owner. No foreground bottleneck, latency improvement or intermittent failure fix is claimed.

localRollout.packaging: PASS: frontend 104/104, native build, TestWorkspaceUpdatePackage, 8-file workspace verification and application setup verification.
localRollout.aBaseline: 34 source profiles from g460; capture reply maximum 57321us. Detailed native stages absent. This is not a matched comparison to the previous day's 324277us outlier.
localRollout.a: Matching g461 UI, agent, launch record and protected installation; doctor healthy, connected, input health READY.
localRollout.bApp: UPDATED; peer reports g461 and matching revision.
localRollout.bProtectedInput: SERVICE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED (1066), predating the g461 update. Awaiting local administrator repair; updated app metadata is not proof of a healthy updated protected worker.

bExistingFailure.limit: The negative preparation report identifies native-child cleanup and ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED, not the exact failing native API. This field failure is not attributed to capture focus or claimed fixed.

localRollout.physicalAcceptance: PENDING: repair B, verify both protected owners, then collect physical crossings.
